string-array.name: legal_consent_bullets
string-array.item: The AI can make mistakes. Treat its output as a draft and verify before acting on anything with real-world consequences (messages, calls, purchases, deletes, settings changes).
Once you grant the agent permissions, it can send messages, place calls, install or uninstall apps, delete files, and modify system settings on your device.
Your chats, screenshots, and API keys stay on your device. The App does not upload them anywhere; there is nothing on our side to delete.
Third-party backends (Samosa AI or a User-Provided Provider you configure yourself) have their own terms and data-retention practices, which apply once a request leaves your phone.
You must use the App lawfully — no hacking, fraud, harassment, illegal activity, or infringement of others\' rights. You are responsible for any damage to your device or data.

resources.string: Every language Gotcha uses, in one place: what the app\'s own screens are written in, what Gotcha speaks and hears, and what it writes its answers in.
Gotcha\'s own buttons, labels and settings are in English only for now — changing this affects the rest of your phone, not this app.
What Gotcha speaks aloud and listens for during voice input and calls. Leave it following the reply language unless you want answers written in one language and spoken in another.
Which model and voice read it out are picked under Settings → AI → Speech.
The language Gotcha writes your speech down in, for voice input, calls and transcribing audio files.
Leave this empty and speech is transcribed in the voice language. Set it to force one language, which helps accuracy when the model tends to guess wrong.
Only Samosa AI and external speech-to-text use this. Android Built-in always transcribes in the voice language.
Only Samosa AI and external speech-to-text use this. Speech-to-text is off.
Your device doesn\'t have Android\'s built-in voice for %1$s. It was spoken in English instead. Install the voice data to fix pronunciation.
The language the assistant writes its answers in. Tool names, commands and file paths stay in English so they keep working.
